title: Basic Granny Square Pattern
author: Cheryl Bennett
notes: start: original "To start, chain 5 and join with a slip stitch." replaced by magic ring. "R1:" etc. normalised to "Round 1:". General instructions for additional rounds (not a numbered round) omitted. R3 "repeat * to * twice" read as the starred section worked 3 times in all (4 corners), consistent with the closing "ch1, 3dc, ch1, join".
